items.title: Germany approves healthcare costs overhaul despite significant pharma opposition
items.summary: There are a range of cost-containment measures across the bill that will create a significant healthcare system shakeup.

items.title: Podcast: Patient advocates join the blood cancer ASCT vs CAR-T debate
items.summary: Patient advocates in remission from MCL and FL discuss their treatment experiences with ASCT and CAR-T, while sharing views on latter's place in the treatment paradigm.

items.title: “Hub-and-spoke” drug manufacturing set to benefit from new FDA rule
items.summary: The proposed rule would allow multiple manufacturing units at different locations to register as one establishment.

items.title: Takeda and Indonesia partner on plasma-derived therapies
items.summary: Takeda and the Indonesian Government have announced a multi-phased collaboration to strengthen the country’s plasma ecosystem and expand access to PDMPs.

items.title: FDA approves MSD’s Keytruda combinations for MIBC
items.summary: The FDA has approved two of MSD's anti-PD-1 therapies, Keytruda and Keytruda Qlex, along with Padcev, for adults with MIBC.
